alignments.note: Interrogative particle takes the fronted auxiliary (rule 17).
Finite verb with its subject pronoun.
The ASV promotes the object of עַל to the direct object of *know* and writes nothing for the preposition (rule 40).
Nomen rectum takes the *of*; the further *the* is supplied for this noun, which carries no article morpheme (rules 19, 15).
Construct substantive with a supplied *The*, headed on *wondrous* (rule 31).
Anarthrous substantival adjective: the supplied *him who* and the copula join its unit and the construct relation supplies the *of*, headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 46, 19, 20).
Nomen rectum of תְּמִים דֵּעִים, with the construct relation recast as *in* (rule 19).

review_notes: The one unrepresented unit is עַל, whose object the ASV makes the verb's direct object.
